name: unmask
tagline: Bot defense that runs inside nginx or Apache
description: unmask is a bot-defense module that lives directly inside nginx or Apache. It combines JA4 TLS fingerprinting with behavioral CAPTCHAs to tell humans from bots, adding only about 0.05ms of overhead per request — and it is explicitly search-bot safe, so SEO traffic is never blocked. By running inside the web server rather than as a separate service, it needs no infrastructure changes and no external round trips to start protecting endpoints.
highlights: JA4 TLS fingerprinting plus behavioral CAPTCHA
Runs inside nginx or Apache with ~0.05ms overhead
Search-bot safe — no SEO collateral damage
No separate service or infrastructure changes required
curatorNote: Bot defense usually means another reverse proxy in front of your stack. Running it inside the web server with a JA4 fingerprint and 0.05ms of overhead is the zero-infrastructure answer, and being search-bot safe is the detail that keeps it deployable.
